newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hannover Rueck's Lehmann joins Zurich Re.
newsitem.headline: Hannover Rueck's Lehmann joins Zurich Re.

text.p: Dirk Lohmann, management board member of both Hannover Rckversicherungs-AG (Hannover Re) and E+S Rckversicherungs-AG (E+S Re) is leaving for the reinsurance section of Zurich Versicherung, German insurance sources said.
A spokeswoman for Hannover Re told Reuters no comment could be made before the meetings of the supervisory boards on Monday and Tuesday next week.
Lohmann will take over a leading position in the Zurich Re group and be responsible for reinsurance business in Europe, with the exception of the UK, and Asia, the sources said.
Zurich Insurance was not available for comment because of a Swiss national holiday.
